$comment: Machine-readable arrow semantics for the q04 compact arm. Orthogonal visual channels: head = regulation sign / direction, line dash = interaction family or 'direction not stated', badge = covalent modification type, line width = evidence strength. Never overload one channel with two meanings. Loaded by scripts/pathway.py (rendering, legend, compliance checks) and scripts/verify.py (independent geometry audit).

head_shapes.circ: open circle = physical binding / association, direction as drawn
head_shapes.none: NO head = the source does not state who acts on whom (direction not stated)

line_styles.dash: interaction family of the modification class, or direction not stated in the source

binds.head: circ
binds.note: partner order is stated by the source (A 与 B 结合); the head marks binding, not activation

regulates_unknown.head: none
regulates_unknown.note: the source says one entity regulates/affects the other without saying which way

unspecified.head: none
unspecified.note: the source states a relation but neither its mechanism nor its direction

direction_policy.requires_direction_true: the evidence quote must contain a directional cue (activates/inhibits/phosphorylates/promotes/blocks/激活/抑制/促进/阻断 …); otherwise the edge is downgraded to 'unspecified' and one entry is appended to result.json.uncertainty[] with handling='undirected'
direction_policy.direction_not_stated: render 'unspecified': dashed line, NO arrowhead, '?' annotation, legend note 'no arrowhead = direction not stated in source'
direction_policy.forbidden: guessing a direction from biological plausibility (e.g. a kinase phosphorylates whatever it binds); such background knowledge may go into notes/uncertainty, never onto the canvas as an arrow

legend_requirements.no_head_note: no arrowhead / '?' = direction not stated in source
legend_requirements.coverage: the legend lists exactly the types used, and a test fails if a type is advertised but unused
